projects.title: A diploma that matters
projects.description:
Education is the foundation of every advanced society. So, naturally, when Universum became our client, we worked with great enthusiasm and dedication on a campaign that made a significant impact.

“Choose a degree that Counts, not just one to own” was based on the fact that Universum provides what a student really needs: the experience and diploma that open new doors and real opportunities in the job market, including the possibility to work in international companies.

The key messages of this communication focused on the value of education, the skills offered by the right university, career…
